What We Do

Foundation repair solutions built to last.

From leaking basement cracks to exterior waterproofing and drainage problems, Mission City Crack Repair provides practical repair options for homes and properties across the Lower Mainland.

Polyurethane Crack Injection

Professional injection repair for foundation wall cracks and water intrusion.

Carbon Fibre Reinforcement

Wall preparation, epoxy resin and carbon-fibre reinforcement for added strength where required.

Exterior Waterproofing

Excavation, foundation preparation, rubberized waterproofing, protective membrane and drainage backfill.

Drain-Tile Flushing

Drainage maintenance to help clear and restore foundation drainage systems.

Camera Inspections

Camera inspection of drainage lines to help identify blockages and other concerns.

Interior & Exterior Repairs

Repair options matched to the location and condition of the foundation problem.
